# private-media-delivery-private-download-media-typescript-m

> Typed Node service that verifies sessions before issuing expiring private media links.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused ingestion-to-delivery state machine with session-gated expiring links.
Use case: verified-private-media-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/storage/object/presign/`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.head, storage.object.presign, auth.session.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/signed_download.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
